notes.title: DRAKERZ-Confrontation : official STEAM launch!
notes.content:
Update 1.4.7 marks the official launch of Drakerz on Steam platform, after its beta version. This update provides a lot of modifications and bug fixing, but also novelties.
 
Changes and novelties :
[list]
    [*]Download problem : download the game easily
    [*]Language : English is now the main language
    [*]New : change of Free deck with 5 brand new cards
[*]New: Simplification of the first 3 fights of the story mode (deck changed and challenges removed)
[*]Story mode: you are no longer stucked on the first fight of the story mode with Felis.
[*]Tournaments: if you’re disconnected after winning, the game doesn’t crash anymore!
[*]Trades : it is possible to trade cards again.
[/list]

 
We remind you that to enjoy augmented reality you need real cards. To get your real cards visit our website : [url=https://www.drakerz.com/starters.html] www.drakerz.com[/url]

 
The drakteam will be pleased to see you soon, in the meantime have fun!

notes.title: Help us to finish the game with KICKSTARTER!
notes.content:
[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/968346344/drakerz-augmented-reality-tcg]Visit us on now KICKSTARTER![/url] [/b]

The game is [b]90 percent complete[/b] and has a beta live now via the Drakerz website or Steam. To complete this version of DRAKERZ-Confrontation, we are seeking an initial $30,000 of funding for the [b]30-day Kickstarter project[/b]. If attained, the funds will be used primarily for art and engineering. We had also included several stretch goals to make further enhancements.

notes.content: Drakerz and Drakos.
